mapper.select: select c.id as class_id, c.class_term, cp.campus_name, crs.course_name, c.start_time, graduate_info.graduate_date, d.teacher_id, coalesce(u.real_name, u.nickname, u.username) as teacher_name, d.remark from edu_class c inner join ( select distinct s.class_id from edu_class_schedule s where s.schedule_date = #{dutyDate} and s.schedule_type in ('CLASS', 'SELF_STUDY') ) active_class on active_class.class_id = c.id left join ( select class_id, max(schedule_date) as graduate_date from edu_class_schedule where schedule_type = 'CLASS' group by class_id ) graduate_info on graduate_info.class_id = c.id left join edu_campus cp on cp.id = c.campus_id left join edu_course crs on crs.id = c.course_id left join edu_duty_assignment d on d.duty_date = #{dutyDate} and d.duty_type = 'CLASS_NIGHT_DUTY' and d.class_id = c.id left join sys_user u on u.id = d.teacher_id order by c.start_time asc, c.id asc

select d.id, d.duty_date, d.duty_type, d.class_id, d.start_time, d.end_time, d.teacher_id, coalesce(u.real_name, u.nickname, u.username) as teacher_name, d.remark, d.created_at, d.updated_at from edu_duty_assignment d left join sys_user u on u.id = d.teacher_id where d.duty_date = #{dutyDate} and d.duty_type = #{dutyType} and d.class_id = 0 limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into edu_duty_assignment ( duty_date, duty_type, class_id, start_time, end_time, teacher_id, remark, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{dutyDate}, #{dutyType}, #{classId}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{teacherId}, #{remark}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} ) on duplicate key update start_time = values(start_time), end_time = values(end_time), teacher_id = values(teacher_id), remark = values(remark), updated_at = values(updated_at)
